# Client communication log

Short notes after each real call, so the next call doesn't start with "wait, what did we agree on
again."

## Acme Robotics — kickoff

Priyanka wants a weekly async status update via email rather than a standing meeting — she's
managing three vendors at once and doesn't want another recurring call on her calendar. Suits me
fine; async writing forces a clearer summary anyway than a rambling call would.

## Riverbend Coffee Co — wrap-up

Project closed out cleanly. Owner mentioned they might want a booking system added in the fall once
the new location opens — noted here so it isn't forgotten by then, since that's months away and my
memory of a one-off comment on a call is not reliable that far out.
